records.title: WPO current consolidation, amendment 4 February 2026
records.checks: Degree is ordinary entry; section 8(2) provides ten years at listed bodies or five years as tax adviser/sworn auditor. No independent Bilanzbuchhalter/Fachwirt shortcut. Section 9 retains audit practice. Section 13b credits only higher-education work in BWL/VWL or law; content/form/extent equivalence assessed. Delegated procedure cannot itself rewrite statutory degree/credit boundaries.
records.limits: Last amendment in header predates both October responses. Only listed passages read; no full 77-page reading claimed.

records.title: WiPrPrüfV current consolidation, amendment 11 December 2024
records.read_extent: Header; complete sections 4–7, 13–19 and 22, selected physical pp. 4–10.
records.checks: Four modules, each written and oral, subject to exemptions. Existing six-year registration period. BWL has two papers; law one; core and tax two. Current papers allow four to six hours. Section 4 lacks a general audit-relevance limitation; tax subjects have no numerical statutory weighting. Oral core includes presentation and professional questions. Module may be repeated twice; whole-exam repeat is a separate route.
records.limits: Current consolidation predates response dates. Legal structure does not measure candidate burden, diagnostic validity, actual examiner questioning frequency or unchanged professional competence.

records.title: WPAnrV current consolidation, amendment 11 December 2024
records.checks: Institutional confirmation may be sought before semester/year. Section 9(2) separately limits elapsed time since a student degree to eight years; do not confuse it with institutional confirmation validity. Section 9(6) permits denial where a material curriculum redesign removes equivalence.
records.limits: The ordinary student eight-year rule is not proof that institutional confirmations already last eight years. Current law predates the October authors; exact September proposal remains separate.
